Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PIG HOOKS 



(Reaffirmed 2005) 



K Scope — Requirements in respect of material, jdimensions, strength, etc, of S-shaped pig hooks. 

2, Material— Stainless steel (round) conforming to 15:1570-1970 'Schedules for wrought steels for 
general engineering purposes' or mild steel, galvanized conforming to IS:277-i969 'Specification for galva- 
nized steel sheets (plain and corrugated) (second rQyis\on)\ 

3. Dimensions — Dimensions of S-shaped pig hool<s shall be as given in Fig. I, 

^ ^165 ^ ^ 




All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. I lyiMENSlONS OF S-SHAPED PIG HOOKS 

4. Requirements 

4.1 The weight of a hoo[< shall be 1 85 g ± 5 percent. 

4.2 The hook shall not bend when a load of 120 l<g is applied, 

5. Workmanship and Finish — The hook shall be free from flaws, burrs, pits and sharp edges and should 
be of uniform weight. 

6. Marking — Manufacturer's name or trade-mark and batch or code number embossed at a convenient 
place. 

6.1 /S/ Certification Morking— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1 10001. 

7. Packing — The hooks shall be packed in wooden boxes or as agreed to between the manufacturer and 
the purchaser. 

8. Sampiin^ — The method of drawing representative samples of pig hooks and the criteria for confor- 
mity shall be as given in Appendix A of IS : 6628-1972 * Specification for slide rails for use in abattoirs'. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Pig hooks are used for hanging portions of carcasses in cold stores, in meat shops and for trans- 
porting carcasses in refrigerated trucks.
